t: Skyrim:Housecarl - UESP Wiki - The Unofficial Elder Scrolls Pages
s: In terms of court politics, housecarls are the equal of court wizards, but less important than stewards and, of course, the jarls. In summary, housecarls are faithful guardians who are very useful in both the royal courts of Skyrim and in the deepest depths of its ruins. ... None of the housecarls appear in the game until you become a thane of their associated hold: Whiterun, Haafingar, The Rift, The Reach and Eastmarch in the original game (in each of which you can buy a house in the major city), with The Pale, Hjaalmarch and Falkreath Hold in the Hearthfire add-on (in each of which you can buy a plot of land to build a house in the country).
